name: cg_top_losers
description:
The 24-hour top losing coins among the 250 largest by market cap, from CoinGecko: SAJHA fetches coins/markets in USD ordered by market cap (250 coins, one call) and ranks them itself by price_change_percentage_24h, lowest first (CoinGecko documents no price-change order). Coins outside the top 250 are not considered.
Returns {coins: [{id, symbol, name, current_price, market_cap, market_cap_rank, price_change_percentage_24h, ...}], universe, ranked_by}; coins have the cg_coin_markets shape.
Inputs (none required): limit (1-100; default 20).
cg_top_gainers is the counterpart; cg_trending_coins lists search trends.
Example: {"limit": 10}
